# Test fixtures

All fixtures are generated by us (no third-party content).

| File | How it was made |
|---|---|
| `sample.heic` | 96×64 orange image with a blue rectangle at (10,10)–(40,50), written with pillow-heif in a throw-away environment (pillow-heif is not an app dependency; ADR-S17). |
| `sample.dwg` | `tests/fixtures/sample.dxf` converted with LibreDWG 0.14 `dxf2dwg` (R2000). |
